checks.title: Colour on backgrounds
checks.summary: weak on mid grey, dark grey, near-black
consider: #1d5e74 is weak on dark grey, near-black. For dark backgrounds, a lighter version with the same hue, #65a3bb, gives dark grey 4.6:1, near-black 6.9:1. Use it only with the owner's agreement; the one-colour white or black version is the other option.
On mid tones (mid grey) no version of the colour is strong. Use the one-colour white or black version there, or keep the logo off mid-tone and busy photo areas.
